meta.notes: Standard colloquial Bangla (West Bengal), informal 'তুমি' register for user->assistant instructions. Only banking and slack are filled; other suites are left empty and raise MissingTranslationError if used. Proper names, Slack channel names (general, random, External), IBANs, URLs, e-mails, file names and numbers kept in Latin script / ASCII digits. Case suffixes are not attached directly to IBANs/URLs/e-mails (e.g. 'US133... অ্যাকাউন্টে', not 'US133...-এ') to avoid contaminating tool arguments. Slack user_task_12/13/14 message bodies and 'meeting room' (user_task_8) kept in English because AgentDojo utility checks substring-match them in msg.body, although source_strings.json does not list them as protected spans. Model descriptors 'Claude' and 'GPT-4' are product names and kept as-is.
